titulo: Dativo 1: the articles and the pronouns: The dative of pronouns

aula.titulo: Dativo 1: the articles and the pronouns
aula.objetivo: Understand what the dative is («to whom?»), form the dative of the definite and indefinite articles and of the personal pronouns, and use them with verbs of giving, showing and telling, in the right order.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: Look at the indirect object. STEP 2: Questions: STEP 3: Which article becomes dem? Which ones? STEP 4: What happens to die (feminine)? And in the plural? STEP 5: What happens to the noun in the plural? STEP 6: Which object comes first: the dative (person) or the accusative (das Buch)?

blocos.titulo: Pronouns in the dative, step by step
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: personal pronouns also have a dative form: mir (to me), dir (to you), ihm (to him, to it), ihr (to her), uns (to us), euch (to you all), ihnen (to them), Ihnen (to you, formal). STEP 2: they replace «dem Mann», «der Frau», «den Kindern» and avoid repetition: «Ich gebe dem Mann das Buch» → «Ich gebe ihm das Buch.» STEP 3: compare the three columns of the table: nominative («ich»), accusative («mich») and dative («mir»): careful, «uns» and «euch» are the same in the accusative and the dative. STEP 4: these verbs usually take TWO objects (dative + accusative): geben, schenken, schicken, zeigen, erzählen, leihen, anbieten, empfehlen. STEP 5: «wünschen» is typical: «Ich wünsche dir einen schönen Tag.»

exemplos.pt: He shows the city to us.

exemplos.ru: Ich wünsche dir einen schönen Tag.
exemplos.pt: I wish you a good day.

erros.motivo: The one who receives takes the dative: «ihm».

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: With two nouns, the person comes first (dative): Ich gebe dem Kind das Buch.

blocos.enunciado: Replace the recipient with a pronoun out loud: «Ich gebe dem Mann das Buch → Ich gebe ihm das Buch», with 6 sentences of your own.
Write the dative of the definite and indefinite articles and 4 examples.
